newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Aug 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Aug 5.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Shortfall in reserves of corporate pensions is expanding.
-- Japan's first gene therapy declared success by doctors.
-- Teenage murder suspect to undergo psychiatric test.
-- Japan to cut costs for maintaining U.S. forces stationed in Japan in budget for fiscal 1998/99, starting in April 1998.
-- U.S. organisation to pay reward for information on illegal copying of computer software.
-- Koichi Kato, Secretary General of Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), is likely to remain in current post.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto to visit Russia in early November.
-- Poll shows approval rate for Hashimoto cabinet at 44 percent.
